resolved_findings.title: Queued inactive pulse can authorize resume before a fresh callback
resolved_findings.resolution: Gate::boundary drains latest without releasing an outstanding queued event token, clears notified/active_since and sets eligible_after to actual boundary Instant. Host forwards this at focus/suspend/resume/resize/scale/restart transitions. Inactive poll also moves eligibility boundary; active ready requires Pulse.arrived>=eligible_after.
resolved_findings.assessment: Both prior stale-data authorization and stale health-origin cases are addressed without changing Clock. New post-boundary callbacks may use the existing token only after delivered acknowledgment; no extra outstanding event is manufactured.

unchanged_assessments: Retained Host owns CADisplayLink, callback target and Tao Window; target State owns only Rc inbox and event proxy, not Host/link, so no Rust ownership cycle found.
stop closes delivery then invalidates; Drop repeats stop before retained link/target/window field teardown.
One latest Pulse and one queued notification bit bound coalescing; acknowledgment and polling consume once; invalid/closed callback state is sticky.

Only explicit macOS feature + trusted CLI selection activates; bound window and stop-after required, conflicting capture/checkpoint/material/minimum-duration modes refused before output/window/audio/GPU setup.
CADisplayLink target timestamp is metadata only; unchanged Clock::due(now), rate60 admission, max4 catch-up, retry/acquisition/input/audio chronology remain in ordinary host path.
Cargo.lock changes only add direct edges to already pinned objc2 packages; no resolved version changes.
